attributes.board_name: South Dakota Board of Nursing (CNP licensure jointly with the Board of Medical and Osteopathic Examiners)

rules.alternatives: No state CE hours for CNP renewal. Renewal requires evidence of current national certification (licensees from before June 26, 1996 are exempt), an unencumbered SD RN license or multistate privilege, and a no-misconduct affidavit.
rules.notes: Renewed biennially; expiration matches the SD RN license, or for multistate RN privilege holders the second birthday after issuance. CE is whatever the national certifying body requires.
